caption: The video captures a close-up view of a burning sparkler set against a uniformly dark background. A bright yellow-white combustion point occupies the center of the frame, with a short orange-red stick visible just below it. From this tip, numerous thin golden spark trails radiate outward in a starburst pattern, several ending in small star-like flares. The sparkler is already burning at the first frame and continues burning steadily through the last frame, the bright central tip and the orange-red stick persisting without extinguishing. The configuration of radiating spark trails changes from frame to frame. Thin streaks continuously shoot outward, extend, and fade, so the overall starburst flickers and reshapes while remaining centered on the tip. A few isolated sparks appear detached from the main burst near the frame edges, positioned farther from the tip than the dense inner spray. The bright tip and stick drift only slightly within the frame, staying approximately centered the whole time.
